title: Injectivity of the recoding map
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and fix a natural-number window size $s$. The map that sends each number in the $s$-window reachability set to the code of the corresponding run configuration in the larger $(s+1)$-window is injective on that set: whenever two numbers in the set have the same image, they are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
Both numbers lie in the $s$-window reachability set
